Data.subject: Manufacturing
Data.title: Total Output In Manufacturing By Industry, Annual
Data.footnote: From 2002, figures include establishments with less than 10 workers.  Prior to 2002, figures refer to establishments engaging 10 or more workers.  Data include all manufacturing establishments.  The industries are classified according to Singapore Standard Industrial Classification (SSIC) 2025.  Total manufacturing output refers to the total value of goods and services derived from a production process and ancillary activities such as management or marketing.  As such, it includes manufacturing output and other operating income.  Valuation of output has been changed to basic price.  Historical total output has been revised accordingly from 1980.  Refers to manufacturing output and other operating income.  Year 2025 data are preliminary estimates.
